intro: Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet aims to capitalize on an exotic culinary craze sweeping Booty Bay: spider egg omelettes. To supply the lucrative overseas market, he hires adventurers to venture into the Stonetalon Mountains and harvest fresh clutches of deepmoss spider eggs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Spider egg omelettes are a new fad in Booty Bay! The problem is... Booty Bay's got no eggs.
In Windshear Crag and Sishir Canyon, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the northwest, lives the deepmoss spider. Bring me its eggs and I'll pay a bundle!
In Windshear Crag, the eggs will be clustered under what trees remain.
In Sishir Canyon... Well, if you have a weak stomach then maybe you should just collect the eggs at Windshear Crag...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you get the eggs, friend? I already made a shipping deal with Wharfmaster Dizzywig!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'll have these sent to Dizzywig and get them shipped to Booty Bay. I can already taste the profits!
Here is your cut, friend. I couldn't have made this deal without you.
